# dsh-web-search-searxng
SearXNG-backed search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
Registers a `WebSearchProvider` into `ctx.web` so that the existing `web_search` model tool routes t
hrough your SearXNG instance. No auth, no API key, no model calls — just a plain HTTP GET against Se
arXNG's JSON endpoint.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web` and

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` exactly at `0.2.1-rc.5`.
`@deepseek-ai/cordis` is the deliberate excepti

on: like the first-party DSH web plugins,
this package declares the compatible patch range `~4.0.5`.

A consumer lockfile could in
principle resolve a different 4.0.x cordis patch and create a second f

ramework copy; this
plugin's one-shot install is verified against cordis 4.0.5. Every DSH bump there

fore needs
a release of this package with its framework peers re-pinned (`test/peer-pins.test.mjs`
e
nforces their presence and pin form). Use 0.1.x of this plugin with DSH 0.1.x.

### 4. (Optional) Configure via the Web UI
Once DSH is running, go to **Settings → Plugins** in the Web UI. You'll see a "web-search-searxng" c
ard where you can edit the `baseURL` and filter settings without editing YAML files.
Every config field is volatile (DSH 0.2 settings model): a change is committed into the running plug
in and the next search reads it, without reloading the plugin.
## How it works

The existing `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web` consumer calls `ctx.web.search()` — your SearXNG instance s
erves the results automatically.
## Provider interface
| Method | Behavior |

| `available()` | Returns `true` when `baseURL` is a valid URL |
| `search(request, signal?)` | `GET
/search` with `q`, `format=json`, optional `language`/`categories`/`time_range` params. Dedupes res
ults by URL. Surfaces `answers` and `infoboxes` as provider-generated answer text. |
## Upstream
This plugin communicates with SearXNG via its JSON API (`/search?format=json`). SearXNG is a free in
ternet metasearch engine which aggregates results from more than 70 search services. You need a runn
ing SearXNG instance to use this plugin.
